{{short description|Romanian biologist (b. 1962)}}
{{BLP sources|date=August 2019}}
'''Cătălin Tănase''' (b. February 19, 1962 in [[Epureni]], [[Vaslui County]]) is a [[Romania]]n biologist ([[Mycology|mycologist]] and [[Botany|botanist]]), professor at the [[Alexandru Ioan Cuza University]] of [[Iași]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Curriculum vitae Europass|publisher=[[Europass]]|url=http://www.bio.uaic.ro/organizare/departament/Prof_Tanase_Catalin_CV_EN.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180711191214/http://www.bio.uaic.ro/organizare/departament/Prof_Tanase_Catalin_CV_EN.pdf|archive-date=2018-07-11|access-date=2024-07-15}}</ref> He is also director of the [[Iași Botanical Garden|Anastasie Fătu Botanical Garden]] of Iași. He was elected a correspondent member of the [[Romanian Academy]] in 2018.
